production_field_vitals.reason: Production Analytics Engine dataset crol_rum_observations_v1 retains LCP/INP/CLS for geography-navigation routes, but the repository sample floor (30) is not met for the required p75 × desktop/mobile matrix on surface near-you after the 2026-09-21 delivery merge. near-you LCP desktop n=2, CLS desktop n=2, INP n=0, and mobile near-you has no rows in the 7d window; percentiles are withheld below the floor rather than published. Earliest near-you floor dates apply the dataset retention ceiling (FIELD_VITALS_DATASET_RETENTION_DAYS): desktop LCP/CLS cannot reach the floor inside that horizon at the queried-window rate and record null with basis insufficient_rate_to_project. Home cells that remain below floor and project inside the horizon keep their window-basis dates.

observation.earliest_date_note: near-you LCP/CLS project to roughly 2026-11-04 at the observed ~0.8 samples/day; INP has no positive rate on near-you so no floor date can be projected for that vital on that surface. If home is admitted as a geography-navigation route surface, mobile LCP/CLS and INP still need more samples (optimistic ~2026-10-08 to 2026-10-11) and INP recently stalled.

route_budget.reason: Simplified geography layer artifacts are present in the repository tree, but a retained full cold-load wire baseline that includes those layer bytes has not been captured. The reduced-copy mobile observation (wire_bytes_p95=484311) was taken without simplified layer artifacts and must not be promoted into a committed ceiling. Per-route readiness/wire sample ceilings in retained_samples stay bounded at <=5% over reviewed pre-merge p95 for the harness timings they describe; the performance-budgets fixture near-you.geography-navigation remains absent until a layer-inclusive baseline is retained.

reduced_copy_mobile_observation.simplified_layer_artifact: not_included_in_this_observation: layers were absent from the reduced copy when measured; layers are present in the current tree but this observation was not re-run

synthetic_field_vitals.reason: Synthetic Near You probe and retained aggregate land for the A7 measurement-group amendment. Resident observation remains in production_field_vitals.observation; groups are never pooled.
